scope: clean RECONCILE Power BI Desktop instance

automation.primary: Accessibility tree was captured, but indexed click failed because input geometry was unavailable.
automation.safeAlternative: Secondary accessibility actions, keyboard alternatives, and screenshot-backed input could not invoke the report controls safely.

interactions.action: Open Incident Drillthrough from one selected incident
interactions.expected: Page 9 opens filtered to the selected IncidentId
interactions.observed: Incident rows were loaded and exposed in the accessibility tree, but both context-click and row-selection alternatives failed because input geometry was unavailable.

interactions.origin: Command Center — severity chart and incident table
interactions.expected: The incident table and related KPIs are filtered
interactions.observed: Five loaded severity bars were exposed as selectable items, but accessibility click and screenshot-backed input both failed in the driver.

interactions.expected: The saved default report state is restored
interactions.observed: Estado padrão was exposed as a live button, but accessibility click lacked geometry and the safe secondary action was unsupported.

interactions.action: Activate ClearAllSlicers after a filter selection
interactions.expected: The page slicer returns to Todos and dependent visuals reset
interactions.observed: Loaded slicers and the live Limpar filtros button were exposed, but accessibility click lacked geometry and the safe secondary action was unsupported.

interactions.action: Navigate to each affected page through the connected Desktop bridge
interactions.expected: The selected page changes and renders its corresponding layout
interactions.observed: All ten pages were selected and captured with loaded data through the connected Desktop bridge; each active-page state matched the requested page.

interactions.action: Move focus with Tab and activate a page with Enter
interactions.expected: A visible focus indicator follows the declared tab order and Enter activates the control
interactions.observed: Tab and Shift+Tab were delivered, but focus remained on the report document root; the page-navigation keyboard shortcut did not change the active page.
interactions.evidence: Accessibility tree observed after both keyboard attempts; visible focus not captured
